最近你忙咩呀: zeoi3 gan6 nei5 mong4 me1 aa - recently busy (what are you busy with lately?)
呢星期，呢月，今年: ni1 sing1 kei4, ni1 jyut6, gam1 nin4 - this week, this month, this year
艘: sau2 - measure word for ships (including spaceships)
了: liu5 - already; equivalent to zo2 (written form)
并: bing6 - and (written form), more formal than tung4
啲: di1 - plural (same di1 as jat1 di1)
金: gam1 - gold (not the same character as below)
金钱: gam1 tin - fortune, currency, money, etc.
边个 / 边位: bin1 go3 == bin1 wai2 - who (wai2 = polite, "seat")
佢系边个: keoi5 hai6 bin1 go3 - he is who?
边啲: bin1 di1 - which ones (vs. bin1 go3, which one)
佢哋系乜嘢人: keoi5 dei6 hai6 mat1 je5 jan4 - they are what kind of people?
佢哋系边啲人: keoi5 dei6 hai6 bin1 di1 jan4 - (which people are they?)
